content: Figure FIGREF10 shows that two baselines achieve similar tradeoff curves, while the constrained model achieves a substantial 52.16% improvement in accuracy at a 77.37% retention rate compared to Unif, thereby showing the benefits of jointly training the encoder and decoder.
